name: Sofia Mendoza
bio:
Sofia Mendoza's journey into motorsport began unconventionally, not with a childhood fascination with racing, but with a deep appreciation for the precision of engineering. Raised in a family of mechanics, she honed her skills working on classic cars before transitioning to the high-pressure world of racing. Her meticulous approach and unwavering focus quickly made her a valuable asset. 

At RFK Racing, Sofia oversees the fabrication and maintenance of critical engine components. She's known for her ability to diagnose and solve complex mechanical issues efficiently, often devising innovative solutions on the fly. Her colleagues admire her dedication and her talent for creating custom tools when off-the-shelf options fall short. What truly sets Sofia apart is her commitment to continuous improvement, always seeking ways to enhance performance and reliability through precision machining and advanced materials.

physical.hairStyle: Long, usually tied back in a practical braid during work, with a few strands escaping to frame her face.
physical.description: Sofia is of medium height with a lean build, a testament to the physically demanding nature of her work.

quirks: Always sharpens her pencils to an almost impossibly fine point.
Has a habit of humming quietly while working on intricate tasks.
Insists on using a specific brand of measuring tape, claiming it's the only one accurate enough.
